## Change class (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Safety-critical: adversarial test added that fails without this change
- [ ] Behavioural (prompt / tools / models / retrieval): online eval gate run and result linked
- [ ] Dependency (ADK / sqlglot): online eval gate run
- [ ] Other

## Checklist
- [ ] `ruff check`, `pytest`, `python evals/run_evals.py` pass locally
- [ ] Traceability / design-decision docs updated if a requirement mapping or decision changed
